title: Tank recovery in Bourguébus
caption: A Sherman recovery tank towing a crippled Sherman through the ruined town. Bourguébus, five miles south of Caen on the road to Falaise, was cleared by British infantry and tanks.
note: No 5 Army Film & Photographic Unit. IWM gives no exact date; Bourguébus was taken in the third week of July 1944
